name: TurnNavigator
description:
Jump between prompts on wide screens: a column of dashes beside the log, one per turn.
The current turn is the accent dash; neighbours of the pointer grow so the target is easy
to hit. Each dash names its prompt in a tooltip; arrow keys, Home and End move.
signature: ({ turns, active, onNavigate }: { turns: TurnAnchor[]; active: number; onNavigate: (index: number) => void; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: active
props.description: The `index` of the current turn; its dash is the accent and the one Tab reaches.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called with a turn's `index` (not its position in `turns`) when its dash is clicked or reached with the arrow keys, Home or End.

props.name: turns
props.description: One dash per prompt, in order: the turn's `index` (its Turn `index`) and a one-line preview for the tooltip.
